analogy.rationale: CDK inhibitors block cell-cycle progression and transcription, producing a strong antiproliferative/transcriptional response; CDC (cell division cycle) inhibitors and Aurora kinase inhibitors act on the same mitotic/cell-cycle machinery, while PLK and general kinase inhibitors overlap downstream. Microtubule inhibitors also cause mitotic arrest but through a distinct target.
